published_scope: Peninsular Spain, Balearic Islands and Canary Islands, population present
definition: Census population present. Subtract Ceuta, Melilla and the remaining African possessions from the published national rows, for each sex and age band.
opening_method: Apply the year-end census age-by-sex shares for the peninsula and adjacent islands to the same-scope January 1900 population using integer largest remainders.
uncertainty: Change in age and sex shares between January 1 and December 31 is unquantified. No age is imputed for people with age not stated.
